div.div: 3 مالأهُ عَلَى الأَمْرِ , (S, K,) inf. n. مُمَالَأَةٌ; (S;) and ↓ مَلَأَهُ ; (K;) but this latter the lexicologists do not hold in good repute; (TA;) He aided, or assisted, him, and conformed with him, to do the thing. (IAar, * AZ, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
